entities.summary: Dana Kiana Evans is an American professional basketball player for the Las Vegas Aces of the Women's National Basketball Association and for the Phantom of Unrivaled. A two-time ACC Basketball Player of the Year at the University of Louisville, she was drafted by the Dallas Wings with the 13th overall pick of the 2021 WNBA draft.
